description:

We don't just follow trends—we set them and drive change. As a market leader in enterprise analytics and AI software, we've pioneered the BI and analytics space, empowering people to make better decisions and revolutionizing how businesses operate. We are now also at the forefront of AI disruption, providing data via our enterprise semantic layer to AI agents, tools, and platforms.


But that's not all. Strategy is also leading a groundbreaking shift in digital assets, adopting bitcoin as our primary treasury reserve asset in 2020\. Since then, we have issued innovative bitcoin\-backed securities and have been the leader in bitcoin treasury companies. This visionary move has helped us build a fortress balance sheet, and is solidifying our position as a forward\-thinking, innovative force in the market.


Our people are the core of our success. At Strategy, you'll join a team of smart, creative minds working on dynamic projects with cutting\-edge technologies. We thrive on curiosity, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.


Our corporate values—bold, agile, engaged, impactful, and united—are the foundation of our culture. As we lead the charge into the new era of AI and financial innovation, we foster an environment where every employee's contributions are recognized and valued.


Join us and be part of an organization that lives and breathes innovation every day. At Strategy, you're not just another employee, you're a crucial part of a mission to push the boundaries of analytics and redefine financial investment.

 **Job Description** **Role Overview**


We are looking for a hands\-on Product Manager to build next\-generation B2B data, analytics, cloud, and AI products. You’ll go deep into technology, understand customer problems, challenge assumptions, and turn complex ideas into simple, high\-impact products.


You will own the product end\-to\-end: vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, execution, launch, and adoption. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Architecture, QE, Cloud Operations, Sales, and customers to deliver scalable, high\-performing, differentiated products.

 **What You’ll Do**

* **Discovery \& Strategy:** Engage deeply with customers to understand pain points and opportunities. Use qualitative and quantitative data to shape product vision and strategy
* **Roadmap \& Prioritization:** Own and refine the product roadmap and backlog. Prioritize work based on customer value, business impact, and strategic goals
* **Execution \& Delivery:** Work daily with Engineering, Architecture, Design, QE, and Cloud Ops in agile teams. Manage trade\-offs, dependencies, and timelines to ship high\-quality products
* **Adoption \& Outcomes:** Define clear success metrics and instrument product analytics. Partner with Sales, CS, and Marketing to drive adoption and measure post\-launch impact
* **Continuous Improvement:** Monitor performance, gather customer feedback, and analyze competition. Iterate to improve usability, performance, and business outcomes

* You think in **products, not projects**
* You start with the **problem, not the feature**
* You understand technology under the hood: architecture, APIs, data, cloud
* You are **data\-driven**, using metrics like funnels, adoption, and retention to make decisions
* You simplify complex problems and care about **performance, scalability, quality, and UX**
* You are resilient, accountable, and follow through on what you commit to
* You value thoughtful design and recognize its impact on adoption and satisfaction
* You collaborate effectively and are comfortable challenging the status quo

**Requirements**

* 4\+ years of strong Product Management experience,
* Proven experience building B2B data, analytics, cloud, or AI products
* Strong understanding of: SQL\-based applications , Cloud data platforms, AI/ML fundamentals, Data governance and data quality
* Good understanding of system architecture, APIs, and cloud technologies
* Exceptional product judgment and end\-to\-end ownership of products
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and prioritization skills
* Strong customer focus, with demonstrated ability to translate customer problems into impactful products
* Excellent communication skills, comfortable engaging stakeholders from engineering to executive leadership

The recruitment process includes online assessments as a first step (logic \+ cultural fit) \- we will send them via e\-mail, please check also your SPAM folder

title: Brand Manager
description:
Role : Brand Manager

Location : Bangalore

About Arkahub

Arkahub is a funded residential rooftop solar company, founded in May 2025 by Manish Pansari (ex\-CXO, Myntra) and Kaustabh Chakraborty (scaled Wakefit; founding team at Urban Ladder). Backed by Kae Capital, Sparrow Capital and Antler. Live in Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune and Nagpur, with Chennai and Dehradun launching soon.

We position ourselves as a home energy company, not a solar installer. Homeowners are making a 25\-year decision, and our brand promise, Engineered to Keep Going, is built on products that are engineered and proven to perform, backed by honest advice.

Why this role exists

The brand function is being built from scratch. This person will own the day\-to\-day running of the brand across every customer touchpoint. We need someone who can own a campaign or a city launch end to end, not just coordinate agencies.

What they will own

* Brand consistency: One look and voice across ads, website, landing pages, sales material, site branding, WhatsApp,

Google Business Profiles and on\-ground assets.

* Briefing: Clear briefs for the in\-house creative team and external partners; turn insights into creative direction.
* Sales enablement: Pitch decks, spec sheets, rate cards, flyers, objection\-handling content and proof assets.
* City launches: Run brand launches for new cities using a repeatable launch kit, with sales, ops and local teams.
* Campaigns and content: Plan and run brand campaigns; support organic content (YouTube, Instagram, blog) and creator partnerships.
* Customer proof: A steady supply of reviews, testimonials, case studies and referral stories.
* Insight and tracking: Support consumer research; track share of search, reviews and brand\-driven leads.

What we're looking for

Must have

* 3–5 years in brand management, ideally in D2C, consumer durables, home improvement, FMCG or another considered\-purchase category
* Strong writing and briefing skills; can define good creative and give sharp feedback
* Has run campaigns or launches end to end, with clear examples of outcomes
* Comfortable in a fast, unstructured startup; takes ownership without waiting for process
* Works well with sales and ops teams, not only creative teams

Good to have

* Experience with high\-ticket, long\-consideration or trust\-led purchases
* Exposure to performance creative (Meta / YouTube) and its effect on cost per lead
* Regional or multi\-city marketing, or influencer and creator work
* Kannada, Telugu, Marathi or Hindi (useful for city launches)

Not a fit

* Candidates who have only coordinated with agencies and not owned output
* Pure social media managers or designers

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 \- ₹1,100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Global Customs IT PDO team partners with internal Mfg. Are you a hands\-on product manager with strong technical leader understanding for creating exceptional developer tools and infrastructure? Global Customs is looking for a Product Manager who embraces Lean, Agile and Human Centered Design practices to deliver innovative software products for Ford Motor Company. As our Developer Enablement Leader, you will be instrumental in shaping the future of our Customs IT practices. You'll lead the charge in evaluating, implementing, and driving the adoption of cutting\-edge technologies and best practices – from CI/CD pipelines and testing frameworks to monitoring solutions. Your work will directly empower our software engineers to build high\-quality software faster and more efficiently. You will also play a key role in enhancing our internal development platform, ensuring it provides a robust and scalable foundation for all our teams. If you possess deep expertise in DevOps principles, modernization through Google Cloud adoption, a relentless drive for automation, and a proven history of building and scaling developer infrastructure, we encourage you to apply.


**What You'll Do:**


**Fuel Developer Productivity:** Your primary mission will be to empower our development teams to be as productive and efficient as possible.


This means:


**Driving Product Strategy:** Owning the product vision and roadmap to ensure Customs IT delivers maximum business value.


* **Product Discovery:** Engaging customers and business stakeholders to uncover needs, validate problems, and identify opportunities before committing engineering investment.
* **Roadmap Prioritization:** Defining and prioritizing the product roadmap based on customer impact, strategic alignment, and delivery feasibility.
* **Stakeholder Prioritization:** Balancing and negotiating competing requests across NA, EU, and IMG stakeholders to focus the team on the highest\-value work.
* **Backlog Grooming:** Owning and continuously refining the product backlog, writing clear epics/stories, and ensuring readiness for sprint planning.
* **Business Value Articulation:** Building the business case for initiatives and clearly communicating expected ROI, cost savings, and developer productivity gains to leadership.

**Orchestrating Innovation:** Conduct experimentation and build products that would accelerate developer flow.


**Cloud\-Native Empowerment:** Playing a vital role in enabling developers to build and deploy applications seamlessly on our chosen cloud platform (GCP, OpenShift, GKE), making the cloud a natural extension of their development workflow.


**Inner Source Evangelist:** Collaborating with teams to cultivate a culture of knowledge sharing and innovation by encouraging developers to contribute to internal customs projects and collaborate across team boundaries – NA, EU, and IMG.


**Promote New Products with AI:** Conduct experimentation and build products that would accelerate developer flow. Design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered solutions for code acceleration and tech debt reduction, leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG).


**DevSecOps Champion:** Driving the adoption of DevSecOps principles and practices, embedding security into every stage of the development lifecycle.


**Lead and Inspire:** You'll be a great leader, mentor, and advocate for our development teams. This means:


**Providing Expert Guidance:** Sharing your deep knowledge on a variety of topics related to developer tooling, best practices, and emerging technologies.


**Lead the Code Reviews:** Leading \&Providing constructive feedback on code quality, architectural alignment, and adherence to best practices.


**Staying Ahead of the Curve:** Keeping your finger on the pulse of the latest industry trends and emerging technologies in the developer tooling space.


**Championing Continuous Improvement:** Continuously seeking ways to improve our platform, processes, and the overall developer experience.


**Collaborate and Communicate:** You'll be a critical bridge between development teams and other stakeholders, ensuring everyone is aligned and working towards a common vision. This means:


**Working Closely with Teams:** Collaborating with development teams, architects, product managers, security teams, and the "Tools" team.


**Communicating Effectively:** Explaining complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Presenting at Events:** Sharing your knowledge and insights at team meetings, workshops, and conferences, inspiring others to embrace new technologies and best practices.


**Acting as a Liaison:** Representing the needs of development teams to other departments, ensuring their voices are heard.


**What You'll Bring:**


* A bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in project management \& software development \- with a focus on Java, Angular, and Spring Boot.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience with Agile methodologies, including defining product vision and strategy, building product roadmaps, and creating and managing backlogs.
* A deep understanding of object\-oriented design principles and patterns.
* A proven track record of driving adoption of developer tools and best practices.
* A deep understanding in modern development tools (VS Code, IntelliJ with CoPilot assistance etc) and technologies (e.g., Git, Gradle, Tekton, Terraform, OpenShift / Kubernetes, SonarQube, Checkmarx, Cycode/ SAST \& FOSSA etc).
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., GCP – Preferred, Azure/AWS – Nice to have).
* Familiarity with agile development methodologies.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Mainframe – nice to have.
* COBOL – nice to have.
* Familiarity with customs regulations, trade compliance processes, or Free Trade Agreement (FTA) requirements – nice to have.

**Additional Skills:**


* Experience with developer enablement initiatives.
* Experience with DevSecOps practices.
* Experience with API design and development.
* Experience with microservices architecture.
* Experience mentoring and coaching junior developers.
* Knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG).

**Key Skills:**


* End\-to\-End Program / Project Management experience
* Java, Angular, Spring Boot is mandatory; good to have experience in GCP implementations.
* Developer Enablement
* CI/CD
* Cloud Technologies – GCP preferably
* Agile Development
* Communication
* Problem\-Solving
* Software Architecture Patterns
* Understanding on Test\-Driven Development (TDD)
* Understanding on Java Full Stack \& GCP offerings
* Understanding on Databases (e.g., PostgreSQL – Preferred; SQL Server, Oracle – Nice to have)

Collaborates closely with business stakeholders to identify and shape demand, strategize on opportunities, and drive the development and delivery of IT products. Oversees the entire product lifecycle to ensure services align with the organization’s strategic objectives and deliver maximum business value. **Role Scope and Distinction:** **Experienced professional*** Performs professional\-level research and analyses in the field of specialization.

1\. Act as Business Analyst for Capital Markets line of business within Treasury. 15\. Coordinate with vendors and oversee their deliverables. (This includes reviewing proposed solutions and delivered code.)
16\. Train business users on applications.


17\. Uphold established processes and quality standards with respect to Business Analysis.
18\. In a post\-production environment, troubleshoot systems and provide solutions to the business as well as the technical teams.

**Education and Experience:**  

Requires a Master’s degree with 5 years of experience or a Bachelor’s Degree with a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in Treasury/capital markets domain, or equivalent combination of education and experience. **Minimum Qualifications:**  

The position demands substantial experience in Risk management domain within a globally\-distributed enterprise. In addition, the candidate is required to have:* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Finance, MBA or related field, 8\+ years of professional experience in Capital markets domain.
* Excellent communication skills (verbal \& written).
* Solid experience as a Business Analyst
* Be adept at presenting agreed concepts to senior audiences and ensuring that the business architecture definitions are clear, and signed off, with any assumptions or dependencies clearly identified and mitigated
* Teamwork and Consensus Building: As a multinational, multicultural institution, success at the World Bank requires the ability to negotiate and facilitate trade\-offs and build consensus and commitment to a recommended direction among multiple stakeholders, with broadly divergent frames of reference. The candidate must also embrace and foster respect for all, including diversity in age, gender and origin, and have a record of developing and mentoring staff to ensure career development and succession planning.

* Excellent personal organization skills and ability to take things to closure without follow\-ups

 **Ideal (additional qualifications)*** Strong Organizational Skills and Business Judgment: Ability to distinguish between what is and is not critical, and to balance on both strategic and short\-term issues. A track record of delivering results under stressful timetables.

• Communication

Senior Manager (B4\-1\) \- Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)


**Location:** Chennai


**Role Purpose**

Lead the strategy, product development, transformation, onboarding, orchestration, and engineering evolution of the Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) portfolio, encompassing SD\-WAN, Secure Service Edge (SSE) and Secure Internet Access.


The role requires deep expertise in Lead\-to\-Order (L2O), Order\-to\-Cash/Order\-to\-Billing (O2C/O2B), and Trouble\-to\-Resolve (T2R) customer journeys, service orchestration platforms, AI\-enabled automation, API\-driven ecosystems, and cloud\-native security architectures. The position will drive seamless customer onboarding, service lifecycle management, policy\-based provisioning, and Zero\-Touch MACD (Move, Add, Change, Delete) operations across the SASE portfolio while enabling scalable digital service delivery and customer experience transformation.


**Key Responsibilities**

**SASE Product Strategy \& Portfolio Management**

* Drive product strategy, portfolio evolution, onboarding, and lifecycle management for SASE services including SD\-WAN, SSE, and Secure Internet Access.
* Define and execute product roadmaps aligned with enterprise security, cloud transformation, and digital connectivity strategies.
* Lead portfolio modernization initiatives to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, automation, and service adoption.
* Partner with business, product management, security architecture, and commercial teams to develop next\-generation managed SASE offerings.

**Product Development \& Engineering Leadership**

* Own end\-to\-end telecom and security software product development, release governance, roadmap execution, and portfolio transformation.
* Lead engineering teams responsible for service onboarding, orchestration, workflow automation, and customer lifecycle management.
* Drive adoption of cloud\-native, API\-first, and microservices\-based architectures across SASE platforms.
* Ensure scalable and secure service delivery through standardized engineering and operational frameworks.

**Digital Customer Journey Transformation**

* Lead transformation initiatives across L2O, O2C/O2B, and T2R value streams for SASE products.
* Drive self\-service capabilities for provisioning, configuration management, policy deployment, service upgrades, and MACD operations.
* Improve customer onboarding, service activation, assurance, incident management, and billing experiences through automation and orchestration.
* Enhance digital channels and customer portals to support secure service consumption and lifecycle management.

**Service Orchestration \& Automation**

* Lead implementation and integration of Service Orchestration platforms, Cisco NSO, MSO, SD\-WAN controllers, and cloud security management platforms.
* Drive onboarding of SASE services onto orchestration platforms for automated fulfillment and service activation.
* Enable policy\-driven provisioning, Zero\-Touch deployment, automated configuration management, and lifecycle automation.
* Govern orchestration architectures spanning CRM, Order Management, Inventory, Security Platforms, Assurance, and Billing ecosystems.

**API \& Ecosystem Integration**
